gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.

gaps.sentence: She keyed ___ the password and logged on.
gaps.explanation: key in = type in (a password, code).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
